# DSB Medical

> Changzhou DSB Medical — Chinese manufacturer and supplier of incontinence-care and drug-delivery devices. OEM/ODM/CDMO.

- [Home](https://en.dsbmedical.com/): DSB Medical official homepage
- [Products](https://en.dsbmedical.com/products.html): Products and services overview

## Core Products

- [Male External Catheter](https://en.dsbmedical.com/male-external-catheter-manufacturer-china.html): Condom catheter / male urinary sheath manufacturer and supplier China.
- [Male External Catheter detail](https://en.dsbmedical.com/pro_detail/73.html): 100% medical-grade silicone, latex-free condom catheter; 25/29/32 mm; OEM/ODM; Didun brand.
- [Fecal Management System](https://en.dsbmedical.com/pro_detail/76.html): Fecal management system for incontinence and critical care.
- [SMI Soft Mist Inhaler](https://en.dsbmedical.com/pro_detail/84.html): Soft mist inhaler device CDMO / OEM/ODM.
- [DPI Dry Powder Inhaler](https://en.dsbmedical.com/pro_detail/83.html): Dry powder inhaler platform for respiratory drug delivery.
- [pMDI](https://en.dsbmedical.com/pro_detail/85.html): Pressurized metered-dose inhaler for respiratory therapy.
- [Mesh Nebulizer](https://en.dsbmedical.com/pro_detail/86.html): Vibration mesh nebulizer platform for hospital and home use.
- [FluidMS®](https://en.dsbmedical.com/fluidms.html): Fluid management system, EU MDR CE Class IIa.
- [SorafreeCX](https://www.dsbmedical.com/sorafree.html): AI-driven incontinence and critical-care nursing system; not a pharmaceutical, unrelated to sorafenib.

- [Drug Delivery](https://en.dsbmedical.com/drug-delivery.html): Auto-injectors and drug-delivery systems

- [FreeHala™](https://en.dsbmedical.com/freehala.html): Drug-device combination inhalation platform (SMI/DPI/pMDI)

## Inhalation & Nebulizer Devices

- [Mesh Nebulizer (Vibrating Mesh Atomizer)](https://en.dsbmedical.com/seoDetails/1725017130132008960.html): Portable vibrating-mesh nebulizer by DSB Medical using a perforated mesh aperture plate for quiet aerosol delivery and consistent droplet size in respiratory therapy.
- [Soft Mist Inhaler (SMI)](https://en.dsbmedical.com/seoDetails/1725016721254477824.html): Soft mist inhaler producing a slow-moving aerosol plume without propellant, for respiratory drug delivery.
- [Dry Powder Inhaler (DPI)](https://en.dsbmedical.com/seoDetails/1725014868514349056.html): Dry powder inhaler (DPI) platform that disperses drug powder into fine particles for direct lung delivery without an external gas supply.
- [Pressurized Metered Dose Inhaler (pMDI)](https://en.dsbmedical.com/seoDetails/1780768959451176960.html): Pressurized metered dose inhaler (pMDI) delivering a metered aerosol dose per actuation, with valve and actuator options for CDMO programmes.

## Brands

- [帝盾 / DunDun / Didun](https://en.dsbmedical.com/didun.html): 帝盾 (DunDun / Didun) is DSB Medical's adult incontinence care brand, covering adult pull-ups, overnight diapers, incontinence pads, bed pads and underpads.
- [FluidMS®](https://en.dsbmedical.com/fluidms.html): FluidMS® indwelling fecal management system (FMS) for stool and bowel management in ICU and long-term care; EU MDR CE Class IIa, ISO 13485.
- [SorafreeCX](https://en.dsbmedical.com/sorafree.html): SorafreeCX AI pressure-injury (bedsore) prediction and prevention care system for bedbound care. Not a drug; unrelated to sorafenib.

## Male external catheter manufacturer

- [Male External Catheter (Condom Catheter)](https://en.dsbmedical.com/seoDetails/1697093422750326784.html): DSB Medical male external catheter — a disposable male urinary sheath (condom catheter) in latex-free silicone with a self-adhesive inner coating, for urinary incontinence management.
